_metadata.description: DEMO RULES - Sample compliance rules for Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
_metadata.disclaimer: These are demonstration rules for system testing. They are NOT official legal requirements. Actual rules must be provided by authorized officials from the Department of Legal Metrology.

rules.title: Manufacturer Name Declaration
rules.violation_message: Manufacturer name is not declared on the package. Every package must bear the name of the manufacturer or packer.
rules.recommendation: Add the full name of the manufacturer or packer on the package label in a prominent and visible location.

rules.title: Manufacturer Address Declaration
rules.violation_message: Manufacturer address is not declared on the package. Full address of the manufacturer or packer must be provided.
rules.recommendation: Add the complete address of the manufacturer or packer including city, state, and PIN code.

rules.title: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.violation_message: Net quantity is not declared on the package. Every pre-packaged commodity must declare the net quantity.
rules.recommendation: Declare the net quantity of the commodity in standard units of weight, measure, or number on the principal display panel.

rules.title: Net Quantity Format Validation
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(b) and Second Schedule - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.violation_message: Net quantity is not declared in standard units of weight or measure as prescribed.
rules.recommendation: Declare net quantity using standard metric units (g, kg, ml, L, cm, m) as prescribed in the Second Schedule.

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
rules.violation_message: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) is not declared on the package. MRP inclusive of all taxes must be declared.
rules.recommendation: Declare the retail sale price of the package (MRP) inclusive of all taxes. Use the format 'MRP ₹XX.XX (inclusive of all taxes)'.

rules.title: MRP Numeric Validation
rules.violation_message: MRP value appears invalid. The declared MRP must be a valid positive amount.
rules.recommendation: Ensure the MRP is a valid positive numeric value in Indian Rupees.

rules.title: Manufacturing/Packing Date Declaration
rules.violation_message: Date of manufacturing or packing is not declared on the package.
rules.recommendation: Declare the month and year of manufacture or packing on the package label.

rules.title: Manufacturing Date Format
rules.violation_message: Manufacturing date is not in a recognized date format.
rules.recommendation: Use a clear date format such as DD/MM/YYYY or Month YYYY for the manufacturing date.

rules.title: Best Before / Expiry Date Declaration
rules.violation_message: Best before / expiry / use by date is not declared on the package.
rules.recommendation: Declare the best before date, expiry date, or use by date on the package. For food items this is mandatory.

rules.title: Expiry Date Must Be After Manufacturing Date
rules.violation_message: Expiry/best-before date appears to be on or before the manufacturing date, which is invalid.
rules.recommendation: Ensure the expiry or best-before date is after the manufacturing/packing date.

rules.title: Batch/Lot/Code Number
rules.violation_message: Batch number, lot number, or code number is not declared on the package.
rules.recommendation: Declare a batch number, lot number, or code number for product traceability.

rules.title: Consumer Care Information
rules.violation_message: Consumer care/helpline contact details are not declared on the package.
rules.recommendation: Provide consumer care details including at minimum a phone number, email, or toll-free number.

rules.title: Common/Generic Name of Commodity
rules.violation_message: Common or generic name of the commodity is not declared on the package.
rules.recommendation: Declare the common or generic name of the commodity on the principal display panel.

rules.title: FSSAI License Number Required for Food Products
rules.legal_reference: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 read with Rule 6 of LMPC Rules
rules.violation_message: FSSAI license number is not declared on the food product package.
rules.recommendation: Display the valid 14-digit FSSAI license number with the FSSAI logo on the package.

rules.title: FSSAI Number Format Validation
rules.legal_reference: FSSAI (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses) Regulations, 2011
rules.violation_message: FSSAI number format is invalid. Expected exactly 14 digits.
rules.recommendation: Ensure the FSSAI license number is exactly 14 digits without spaces or special characters.

rules.title: Country of Origin for Imported Goods
rules.violation_message: Country of origin is not declared on the imported product package.
rules.recommendation: Declare the country of origin prominently on the package for all imported goods.

rules.title: Importer Name and Address for Imported Goods
rules.violation_message: Importer name and address is not declared on the imported product package.
rules.recommendation: Declare the full name and address of the importer on all imported product packages.

rules.title: Packer Name and Address
rules.violation_message: Name and address of the packer is not declared when different from the manufacturer.
rules.recommendation: If the packer is different from the manufacturer, declare the packer's name and complete address.

rules.title: Ingredients List for Food Products
rules.legal_reference: FSSAI (Packaging and Labelling) Regulations, 2011 read with LMPC Rules
rules.violation_message: Ingredients list is not declared on the food product package.
rules.recommendation: List all ingredients in descending order of their composition by weight or volume.

rules.title: Veg/Non-Veg Symbol for Food Products
rules.violation_message: Vegetarian/Non-vegetarian symbol is not displayed on the food product.
rules.recommendation: Display the green dot (vegetarian) or brown/red dot (non-vegetarian) symbol as required by FSSAI regulations.

rules.title: MRP Inclusive of All Taxes Declaration

condition.contains: inclusive of all taxes|incl. of all taxes|incl of taxes|inclusive of taxes|all taxes included

rules.violation_message: MRP declaration does not mention 'inclusive of all taxes' as required.
rules.recommendation: Add the phrase 'inclusive of all taxes' or '(incl. of all taxes)' alongside the MRP declaration.

rules.title: Allergen Information for Food Products
rules.violation_message: Allergen information is not declared on the food product package.
rules.recommendation: Declare allergen information prominently, including common allergens such as nuts, gluten, dairy, soy, etc.
